scope: Exploratory follow-ups, selected from the first observed timeouts; do not pool with the primary baseline.

jobs.name: horizon-seed-0
jobs.purpose: Observe continued behavior beyond the nominal 15 s deadline without resetting.

jobs.name: continuation-seed-0
jobs.purpose: Change stochastic draws after step 300, retaining physical and recurrent state; validate the entire prefix against horizon-seed-0.

jobs.name: continuation-seed-1
jobs.purpose: Second stochastic-continuation probe, with full prefix validation.

jobs.name: arm-clip
jobs.purpose: Remove the released six-coordinate gripper-style binarization; diagnostic variant, not the primary filter.

jobs.name: alternative-start
jobs.purpose: Try alternative stochastic trajectories from the same physical starts, with the released filter unchanged.
